title: The Girl Who Found His Silence
short_hook: A child's game breaks a man's walls.
description:
A quiet man guards his heart with routine, until a persistent little girl refuses to leave. What begins as a search for a lost ball becomes a journey back to a love he thought was gone forever. Watch till the end - you won't see the twist coming. What would you say to someone you've shut out for years?

An original story. This video was made with the help of AI tools (script and visuals).
